pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. comment.comment:
This is no longer about money.

Money can be made with any project featuring the stupid face of some rich guy plastered all over a coin. I’ve been part of this project since day one because I felt for Louka and the cause he’s fighting for. And even though I’ve never met Pepper, I’ve come to love this little girl with all my heart.

If I make money along the way, that’s great. Because then I’ll be rewarded for doing something I genuinely love, something that comes naturally to me: valuing life and spreading love to every helpless being who deserves to be protected.

To the Canadian authorities: if you’ve invested so much effort into capturing Pepper and Louka, I have to ask myself whether your country really is the paradise it claims to be, free of violence, crime, and wrongdoing. Are there truly no more pressing issues that deserve your attention than pursuing and hunting down a helpless little animal and a man who has done nothing but give her love?

Saving Pepper has become our mission. The token is now just a consequence of that mission, not the reason behind it.

From this moment on, we are more than a token. We are a movement. We stand for compassion, for justice, and for the belief that every innocent life deserves a chance.

Let's do this, Pepper Army. Let's make history. Let's bring Pepper home 🦝🖤
